page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a balanced ratio of compute power to memory, aligning with general-purpose and compute-heavy workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. However, the lack of local storage requires relying on external network storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs compared to local NVMe options. The absence of a GPU limits its applicability for hardware-accelerated machine learning tasks. This configuration is suitable for enterprise application servers, medium-to-large databases, web serving, and CI/CD pipelines.
